supporting_pages.title: Import metadata into Dataproc Metastore \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: After the import completes, it appears in a table on the Service detail page on the Import/Export tab. gcloud CLI To import metadata, run the following gcloud metastore services import gcs command: gcloud metastore services import gcs SERVICE ID \ --location= LOCATION \ --import-id= IMPORT ID \ --description= DESCRIPTION \ --dump-type= DUMP TYPE \ --database-dump= DATABASE DUMP Replace the following: SERVICE ID : the ID or fully qualified name of your Dataproc Metastore service.

For Avro, to use the Cloud Storage bucket for import: grant your user account and the Dataproc Metastore service agent the Storage Object Viewer role ( roles/storage.objectViewer ) on the Cloud Storage bucket containing the metadata dump being imported.

For Avro, to use the Cloud Storage bucket for import, grant your user account and the Dataproc Metastore service agent: storage.objects.get on the Cloud Storage bucket containing the metadata dump being imported.
